info.name: Veyra Mail — disposable HTTPS acceptance
info.description: Disposable isolated loopback fixture only. Real HTTP auth, admin, settings, errors, audit, owner and foreign mailbox checks, local OAuth callback/profile/revoke. Never contact Google or external mail servers. Read README.acceptance.md. No embedded credentials.
